art_direction: County Fair Toy style (docs/art/ART_DIRECTION.md): bright daylight countryside race day, chunky toy-like proportions, soft hand-painted colour, natural horse coats. Horses always look healthy, calm and happy. No whip, crop or spurs. No wagering or casino imagery. ORIGINAL designs only: no Spirit, My Little Pony, Horse Life, Wild Horse Islands or real racing brand or silks look-alikes. The player's Roblox avatar is the jockey, so no rider is ever generated.

budget.note: One attempt per slot. Run P0 first; the gap between 130 and the 200 cap covers one horse re-roll (30) plus one prop re-roll (30), or P2 if no re-rolls are needed. Negatives are art-direction notes only; the text-to-3D API has no negative prompt field.

defaults.style_suffix: stylized cartoon game asset, chunky readable silhouette, soft hand-painted colors, bright sunny daylight palette, single object, no base, no text, no logos

slots.prompt: full body stylized thoroughbred racehorse in a smooth mid-gallop pose seen from the side, front legs reaching forward and hind legs pushing back, all four legs clearly separated, head and neck stretched forward, ears pricked forward, bright calm happy eyes, relaxed closed mouth, glossy healthy bay coat with black mane, black tail and black lower legs, short tidy mane, flowing tail, slightly chunky toy-like proportions with a sturdy neck, strong legs and large rounded hooves, simple brown leather bridle and reins, small flat brown racing saddle on a plain white saddle cloth, riderless
slots.texture_prompt: glossy healthy bay horse coat, warm reddish brown body, black mane, tail and lower legs, soft hand-painted shading, clean plain white saddle cloth, simple brown leather bridle and saddle, bright daylight colors
slots.negative: no rider, no whip, no crop, no spurs, no wings, no horn, no pastel or rainbow colors, no oversized anime eyes, no eyelash makeup, no pinned-back ears, no white of the eye showing, no flared nostrils, no open mouth, no foam or sweat, no visible ribs, no bandages, no number or text on the saddle cloth, no brand logos, no real racing silks
slots.notes: Race mesh, bay coat. Static gallop pose moved by tweens (bob + pitch synced to the stride beat); Meshy rigging is humanoid-only. Saddle cloth stays plain white: the lane colour and pattern go on a separate overlay part (P1) and the lane badge billboard (P0 2D). The avatar jockey welds to the saddle. Roblox import limit is 20k tris per MeshPart; 8k x 8 lanes = 64k on screen.
